_about: The word lint's strict gate (R7, decision 45), run by build/tools/review/checks.mjs as `words.mjs --strict --only a --dirs <enforce>`: any string literal typed in game code (G26) in an enforced folder fails the check. `ready` folders are listed, reported and not yet enforced: move one to `enforce` when its engine step reports 0 literals (`node build/lint/words.mjs --only a --dirs js/clinic`).
